readout.determinism_strength: Beyond the binary metric, all 601 greedy response STRINGS are byte-identical across every compared pair (R1 vs R2, R1 vs cached, R2 vs cached, at both steps). Greedy decoding in this harness is bitwise reproducible across replicate, across node (an12 vs an29), across GPU index, across date, and -- at step 100 -- across generation harness.
readout.statement: MEASURED FLOOR IS ZERO. Re-evaluating the same checkpoint twice under the cached decoding contract produced 0/601 discordant items on acc_final and 0/601 on acc_strict, at BOTH step 400 and step 100, and both replicate accuracies equal the cached accuracy exactly (step 400: 267/601 = 0.4442595674; step 100: 262/601 = 0.4359400998). The turnover/floor ratio is undefined because the denominator is zero; the floor-subtracted turnover is 137 - 0 = 137 items. Measurement noise in this harness is therefore 0 items, and all 137 step-100-to-400 flips are policy differences between the two checkpoints, not evaluation or decoding noise.
